notes: Orodha ya mitandao ya WiFi sasa iko kwenye skrini ya bluu yenyewe (kidirisha cha Samsung kilisema 'Unlock to view networks'): chagua mtandao au andika jina na nenosiri, kisha Unganisha. Vitufe vyeupe; skrini inarudi juu ya kufuli ya Watu yenyewe. / The Wi-Fi network list is now on the blue screen itself (Samsung's panel said 'Unlock to view networks'): pick a network or type its name and password, then Connect. White buttons; the screen puts itself back above Watu's lock by itself.
